Metadata.title: Studiohut — Find your space
Metadata.description: Discover photography, podcast, dance and event studios in one place.

Home.title: Find the studio your idea deserves.
Home.subtitle: Compare professional spaces for productions and events, then connect directly with the business.
Home.categoriesSubtitle: Explore categories based on what you need.
Home.categoriesEmptyBody: Active categories will appear here as they are added. You can keep exploring in the meantime.

Home.trustTitle: The right space. Clear details. Easy contact.
Home.trustBody: Studiohut brings professional studios together with verifiable information and clear details.
Home.businessBody: Make your space discoverable and manage inquiries in one place.
